about: Every sentence of the interface, for this language. build.py uses them in the generated pages and passes the runtime ones to the browser script. {placeholders} are filled by the build. A key ending in _one/_many is a plural pair.
search_scope: Full text covers every page of this edition: the chapters, the introduction, the part openings, the glossary, the checklist actions and the guide pages.
search_none: No match in the pages of this edition.
search_error: The search index could not be loaded. Check the connection and open the search again.
contents_lead_actions: , and all {n} actions on one page
actions_page_lead: The {actions} actions of the {chapters} chapters on a single page. A tick here is the same tick as in the chapter checklist, so each action counts once.
missing_js_ticks: Ticking an action needs JavaScript. The list stays readable without it.
one_action_at_a_time: One action at a time is enough.
see_all_actions: See all actions on one page
see_all_n_actions: See all {n} actions on one page
storage_sentence: Your ticks and read marks are saved in this browser only, on this device, with no account.
storage_unavailable: This browser does not allow local storage here, so your ticks last until you close the page.
progress_help: Tick actions in a chapter checklist, or on the page of all actions, to update the actions count. Use the "I have read this chapter" checkbox at the end of a chapter to update the reading count. Scrolling through a page does not mark it as read.
ticks_removable: Ticks can be removed at any time from each checklist.
clear_progress: Clear my progress in this browser
confirm_clear: Confirm: clear all ticks and read marks
progress_cleared: Your progress in this browser has been cleared.
coverage_text: This edition contains {chapters} chapters with their {actions} actions{extras}. These numbers describe the available content, not your completion.
coverage_other_editions: Other editions and languages are listed under the language button of the header.
about_text: {edition} of {title}, published by {community}. The book is free to copy, adapt and republish: any community can fork it and change its look, layout, navigation, structure, content and code.
about_contact: Found a mistake or want to suggest a tool? Contact {community}: {contact}.
about_no_ads: No ads and no account. Only the source links you open lead to other sites.
licence_note: Fonts and other third-party resources keep their own terms.
offline_ready: Offline copy: saved in this browser. Every page of this edition, the search, the glossary and all actions open without a connection. Links to other sites need a connection.
offline_saving: Offline copy: being saved in this browser. Keep this page open and online for a moment.
offline_failed: Offline copy: not saved. Reload this page while online to try again.
offline_none: Offline copy: not available in this browser. The pages work online.
start_lead_2: Pick a concrete need, explore its chapter, then start with 1 action suited to your situation.

checklist_explained: Each chapter ends with a checklist where every action is tagged with its effort, such as 5 min or 1 hour. Do 1 action at a time.
guide_intro: The introduction explains why the book exists and how to use it.
guide_parts: Each part opens with a short essay: {links}.
guide_glossary: The glossary explains the words that come back.
guide_actions: All {n} actions are also gathered on one page.
next_part_essay: Part {n} opens with an essay: {title}
directory_lead: Communities that publish their own edition of this book and asked to be listed here. Each one is independent: its own site, its own adaptations, its own choices. The list is kept by hand in the source repository and does not claim to be complete.
directory_empty: No other edition is listed in this copy of the book yet.
not_found_text: The address does not match a page of this edition.
meta_cover_description: {title}, a learning book on privacy, digital autonomy and money. {edition}.
meta_actions_description: The {actions} actions of the {chapters} chapters of {title} on one page, with the same ticks as the chapter checklists, saved in this browser only.
meta_directory_description: Independent editions of {title} published by other communities.
recordings_note: The recordings are hosted by other sites and need a connection. Nothing is loaded from those sites until you play a recording; that site then receives your request like any visit. The recordings keep the rights of their authors and are not covered by the licences of this book.
